data_fields.name: logic_step_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 40 (UI step; world step from the game speed not read)

data_fields.name: render_interval_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 / MaxFramerate (user setting, default not read) or the logic step when CapFramerateToGameFps is set

best_idea: One clock decides when a fight step runs, every step is followed by exactly one drawn frame, and a stall over 250 ms is dropped instead of replayed.
decision_why: Take the pass order and the backlog drop for the client fight clock; Frankendom kills are server-verified, so the client only draws and sends intake and the lockstep network gate is not copied.
acceptance: A duel stalled for 300 ms resumes at the current step with no fast-forward of the missed steps, and each fight step has exactly one drawn frame; a fake-clock test asserts both.
